subject: Linguistics
title: Lingua Francas
description: A quick win: understand Lingua Francas.

hook.text: English is today's global lingua franca—but 500 years ago, it was Latin, and before that, Greek.

buildup.text: A lingua franca is a bridge language used between speakers of different native languages.

discovery.text: Swahili serves as a lingua franca across East Africa, connecting dozens of language communities.

twist.text: Lingua francas reshape themselves—English spoken as a lingua franca differs from native English.

climax.text: Non-native speakers of English now outnumber native ones—the language is being reshaped globally.

punchline.text: A language belongs to whoever uses it—not just those born into it.

quiz.question: What is a lingua franca?
options: A bridge language between different native speakers
The oldest language in the world
